children: AdaptHealth reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $745.65 million, up 10.9% from the prior-year quarter, while net income attributable to the company was a loss of $153.99 million compared with income of $24.51 million a year earlier. Diluted EPS was a loss of $1.13, versus income of $0.17 per share.
¹ Reported as “Net revenue”. ² Reported as “Net (loss) income attributable to AdaptHealth Corp.”. ³ Reported as “Diluted income per share”.
Nine-month revenue increased 9.7% to $2.17 billion, with growth across all segments.
Capitated revenue represented 14.8% of third-quarter revenue, up from 4.7%, led by a contract launched in the third quarter of 2025.
Nine-month Respiratory adjusted EBITDA rose 12.1%, while Sleep and Wellness adjusted EBITDA declined.
AdaptHealth agreed to sell Diabetes Health for $235 million, with closing expected in the first quarter of 2027, subject to customary conditions.
A June cyber incident exposed some patient data, but operations and patient services were unaffected. The company also completed cost-reduction actions.
